item.title: vLLM
item.description: The vLLM app image is built on top of a flagos-runtime image and packages a ready-to-run vLLM server with vllm-plugin-FL.

item.title: Megatron
item.description: The Megatron app image is built on top of a flagos-runtime image and packages a usable megatron-core library for megatron-lm based training.
